reference.question: A geometric sequence has \(a_2=6\) and \(a_5=48\), and its common ratio is positive. What is the common ratio?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Relating two geometric-sequence terms

\(a_5=a_2\cdot q^3\), \(48=6q^3\), \(q^3=8\), \(q=2\).
